The diff against the baseline shows that exactly those three predicates changed. Reservation and strip faces are still excluded, because any owner other than null or `land:<n>` is refused. **The choices row.** C-0265 (1) refines C-0245 (2). **The unit test.** `land.test.ts` (with the opt-in `support.ts` `landOwner`, which gives `land:0` to the L0 face in S1's batch) asserts the following. Before S6, every L1 face except the plaza's is `land:0`. After S6, landHa > 0 and districts > 0, and the report, districts, seams, quarters and typing equal the run without an S1 owner. Every L1 face is re-owned as on that run, with districts inside and the hinterland outside. Every L0 face still has `land:0`. The plaza face keeps `plaza:0`. `isS1LandOwner` accepts and refuses exactly the listed ids. `s6Takes` behaves as specified on inside, outside, margin, water and other owners. **End to end, from mirror m1 with `base.ts` byte-identical to the tree's.** M0-x-04's `packages/layout/test/pipeline/base/run.test.ts` gives `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 13 passed (13)`, exit 0. **This seat's owner-area probe** (m1, with `base.ts`'s S6 adapter instrumented to read only) recorded these results.
